content.text: The text reviews intestinal and tissue parasites, including threadworms, hookworm, trichina, Guinea-worm, and filarial species, describing their life cycles, symptoms, transmission, prevention, and historical treatments. It then surveys liver disorders: biliousness, lithaemia, temporary glycosuria, jaundice, hepatic congestion, perihepatitis, cirrhosis, liver abscess, acute yellow atrophy, phosphorus poisoning, cancer, amyloid degeneration, fatty liver, and bile-duct catarrh. Emphasis is placed on symptoms, pathological anatomy, diagnosis, prognosis, diet, and largely nineteenth-century therapies. Recommended preventive measures include filtered or boiled water, thoroughly cooked pork, dietary moderation, exercise, and avoidance of alcohol. John went to the hallway.
